packet-09 -- unverified image-only reading
==========================================

Exposure note: no proposed identification or reading of this text was in my context. My session context (the operator's memory index) mentions in passing a "Fragmentarium" project and a "Stams revisit", without naming any work; the images themselves carry pencilled shelfmark labels "Stams, STA, Frag. 119-1r ... 5r". I did not use either to identify anything. Nothing beyond the brief's rules was done except reading image pixel sizes with `sips` to tell overviews from tiles.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001, overview of face 1; image-012 presumably face 2)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
image-001: five separate parchment fragments laid on black card with a colour checker and ruler. Each carries a pencilled modern label:
 - Frag. 119-2r (lower left, largest, roughly rectangular): single column, ca. 33-34 lines of small cursive gothic (bookhand/cursiva) in brown ink, a few red strokes (red initial/paraph marks, e.g. top right line 1, ca. line 8 right). Holes/losses along left-middle (lines ca. 4-8 and 13-14). Blank lower margin with label.
 - Frag. 119-4r? (top centre, narrow strip): single column, ca. 22 lines; red underlining and red letters; a red-ink boxed marginal note at right (ca. lines 4-5). Pencil label on right edge (vertical).
 - Frag. 119-5r (top right, strip): 4 lines, red initial at line 2 left.
 - Frag. 119-?r (middle right strip, labelled "...119-6r"?): 4 lines in two parts with a column gap (left column only ca. 2-3 words per line visible, right column text); red initial at line 1 left col.
 - Frag. 119-3r (bottom centre, narrow): single column, ca. 33 lines, red initials (C-forms) and red underlining, red-boxed marginal note at right (ca. lines 9-10, reads "D.. / com..."). Vertical pencil label.
 - Frag. 119-1r (bottom right, large): single column, ca. 33 lines, cursive gothic with red initials/paraphs scattered (e.g. line 3, lines 25, 28). Stain upper middle, holes middle-left.
Script throughout: small, heavily abbreviated late-medieval gothic cursive; red touching and red underlining of words (likely names/citations -- interpretation). Tiles 002-011 are native crops; order to be established tile by tile.

------------
